title: data of sapu slim --json
description: A report only: sapu slim never changes an app. The sizes are a lower bound; whatever Sapu could not read is not counted.

foreign_architecture.description: The other one; its code is what apps could drop.

languages.description: The languages you use, most preferred first, like en-US.

apps.description: Apps with something to save, the largest saving first.

foreign_arch_bytes.description: Size of the slices for the other architecture in fat binaries that also have a slice for this Mac.

language_bytes.description: Size of the *.lproj folders for languages you do not use (Base.lproj excluded).
